# TildaZ v0.10.5

**Snappier typing, much less memory, and TildaZ now starts even with a broken config file.**

- What you type shows up one frame sooner on Linux, and no longer sometimes lags a frame on macOS and Windows. ([#763](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/763))
- Uses much less memory. ([#762](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/762))
- TildaZ starts even when the config file is not valid TOML or names a font that is not installed. It uses defaults and tells you what it changed. ([#758](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/758))
- Italic and bold now show on every platform, even when the font has no italic or bold file. ([#759](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/759))
- While a dialog is open, TildaZ stays behind it. The hotkey brings the dialog to the front instead of hiding TildaZ and leaving the dialog alone on screen. ([#801](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/801))

## Upgrade notes

- Linux: GPU rendering now needs OpenGL ES 3.0. Older GPUs without it (for example Raspberry Pi 3 and earlier) use software rendering instead. ([#762](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/762))
- If you bound the same key to two actions in `[keys]` yourself, neither action gets it now (one of them used to keep it). The startup dialog names both. ([#758](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/758))
- New config files no longer bind `Ctrl+PgUp` / `Ctrl+PgDn` (`Cmd+PgUp` / `Cmd+PgDn` on macOS) to previous / next tab. Existing config files keep them. Use `Ctrl+Shift+[` / `]` instead. ([#760](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/760))

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux portable (glibc 2.28+) | `tildaz-v0.10.5-linux-{x86_64,aarch64}.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./install.sh --release`; no `sudo`. |
| Linux Debian / Ubuntu | `tildaz_0.10.5-1_{amd64,arm64}.deb` | Install with `dpkg` or a graphical software installer. |
| Linux Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE | `tildaz-0.10.5-1.{x86_64,aarch64}.rpm` | Install with `dnf` or the distro package tool. |
| Linux distro-independent | `TildaZ-0.10.5-{x86_64,aarch64}.AppImage` | Make executable and run; FUSE is optional. |
| Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS | `tildaz-0.10.5-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` | x86_64 package. |
| macOS 14+ universal | `tildaz-v0.10.5-macos.dmg` | Apple Silicon and Intel; stable self-signed identity, not notarized. |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `tildaz-v0.10.5-win-x64.zip` | Unzip and keep `_internal\` next to `tildaz.exe`. |
| Windows 11 ARM64 | `tildaz-v0.10.5-win-arm64.zip` | ARM64-native binary; same layout as the x64 zip. |
